ideas.title: Uncovering the Full Extent of Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the number of cases, the amount of money allegedly stolen, and the individuals and organizations involved.
questions: How widespread is Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale pattern of fraud, with significant implications for the state of Minnesota and its residents.
